definitions.gloss: same age group; same generation; peers
definitions.explanation: People who belong to the same age bracket or generation. Used to describe someone of roughly the same age, not necessarily the exact same year.

examples.japanese: {同年代|どうねんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I have many friends of the same age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同年代|どうねんだい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think she's about the same age as me.

examples.japanese: {同年代|どうねんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかり→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: When I talk with people of the same generation, it's easy to find common topics.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) and ⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧ (age group/era). Refers to people who are roughly the same age — not necessarily born in the same year, but within the same general bracket (typically within about 5 years).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同年代|どうねんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: person of the same age group
- {同年代|どうねんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: children of the same age
- {同年代|どうねんだい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧: compared with one's age group
- {同年代|どうねんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧: average for the age group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同世代|どうせだい}→同世代：17141_dousedai⟧: same generation — very close in meaning but emphasizes generational identity (shared cultural experiences) rather than just age
- {同年齢|どうねんれい}: same age — refers to the exact same age, more precise than {同年代|どうねんだい}
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: same year/cohort — people who entered a school or company in the same year
